entries.title: C0041: claimed 2026 resolution of directional transience implying ballisticity
entries.statement: As of 2026-10-10, a September 23, 2026 OpenAI preprint states this result: for an iid law of nearest-neighbor site transition rows on Z^d, d >= 2, with a deterministic positive lower bound on every directional transition probability, annealed almost-sure transience X_n dot l -> +infinity in a fixed unit direction l implies X_n/n -> v almost surely for a deterministic v with v dot l > 0. The paper thus claims a resolution of C0041. Its formalization manifest names OAI.DirectionalTransience.directional_transience_implies_ballisticity in OAI/Probability/Ballisticity/Main.lean, separate from a ComparatorChallenges template containing sorry. This status entry reports the preprint claim; an independent mathematical audit and reproduced Lean build with trusted-axiom inspection are pending, so the claim is not certified by this entry.
assumptions: nearest-neighbor random walk on Z^d in iid site transition rows
uniform ellipticity: one deterministic kappa > 0 bounds all allowed transition probabilities below almost surely
annealed P_0(X_n dot l -> +infinity) = 1 for a fixed unit vector l
entries.domain: probability; random walk in random environment; literature status as of 2026-10-10

relations.rationale: The new concept quotes the 2026 paper's claim that transience in one fixed direction yields positive velocity; the existing C0041 card asks whether transience in direction l under UE and IID implies ballisticity. The relation records this exact matching target, not an audited proof.
